Query Final: SELECT COUNT(a.Application_ID) AS Total_Applications FROM l2_loans_sch.Fact_application a JOIN l2_loans_sch.business_date b ON (a.date_key / 100) = (CASE WHEN (b.bd_id / 100) % 100 = 1 THEN (b.bd_id / 100) - 89 ELSE (b.bd_id / 100) - 1 END);
Prompt: How many mortgage applications were submitted during the last month?

Query Final:
SELECT COUNT(f.Application_ID)
FROM l2_loans_sch.FACT_APPLICATION f
JOIN l2_loans_sch.DIM_STATUS_REF s ON f.Status_Key = s.Status_Key
JOIN l2_loans_sch.business_date b ON 
  (f.Date_Key / 100) = CASE 
    WHEN (b.bd_id / 100) % 100 = 1 THEN (b.bd_id / 100) - 89 
    ELSE (b.bd_id / 100) - 1 
  END
WHERE s.Application_Status = 'Approved';
Prompt: How many mortgage applications were approved during the last month?

Query Final: SELECT COUNT(f.Application_ID) FROM l2_loans_sch.FACT_APPLICATION f JOIN l2_loans_sch.DIM_STATUS_REF s ON f.Status_Key = s.Status_Key WHERE s.Application_Status = 'Pending';
Prompt: How many mortgage applications are currently pending for approval?

Query Final:
SELECT b.Channel_Type, COUNT(f.Application_ID) AS Approved_Applications_Last_Month
FROM l2_loans_sch.FACT_APPLICATION f
JOIN l2_loans_sch.DIM_BRANCH b ON f.Channel_Key = b.Channel_Key
JOIN l2_loans_sch.DIM_STATUS_REF s ON f.Status_Key = s.Status_Key
JOIN l2_loans_sch.business_date bd ON (f.Date_Key / 100) = 
  CASE 
    WHEN (bd.bd_id / 100) % 100 = 1 THEN (bd.bd_id / 100) - 89 
    ELSE (bd.bd_id / 100) - 1 
  END
WHERE s.Application_Status = 'Approved'
GROUP BY b.Channel_Type;
Prompt: How many mortgage applications were approved last month through different channels?

Query Final:
SELECT 
    dlm.Risk_Category AS Risk_Category, 
    COUNT(fa.Application_ID) AS Total_Discharged_Applications,
    dlm.account_status AS Account_Status
FROM l2_loans_sch.FACT_APPLICATION fa
JOIN l2_loans_sch.DIM_LOAN_MASTER_2 dlm 
    ON fa.Application_ID = dlm.Application_ID
JOIN l2_loans_sch.business_date bd 
    ON (fa.Date_Key / 100) = 
    CASE 
        WHEN (bd.bd_id / 100) % 100 = 1 THEN (bd.bd_id / 100) - 89 
        ELSE (bd.bd_id / 100) - 1 
    END
WHERE 
    dlm.account_status = 'Discharged' 
GROUP BY 
    dlm.Risk_Category, 
    dlm.account_status;
Prompt: How many sub-prime and prime mortgage applications were discharged last month?

Query Final:
SELECT SUM(fd.Disbursed_Amount) AS Total_Disbursed_Subprime
FROM l2_loans_sch.FACT_DISBURSEMENT fd
JOIN l2_loans_sch.DIM_LOAN_MASTER dlm ON fd.Loan_Key = dlm.Loan_Key
WHERE upper(dlm.Risk_Category) = upper('sub-prime')
  AND (fd.Date_Key / 100) = (
    SELECT (bd_id / 100)
    FROM l2_loans_sch.business_date
    ORDER BY bd_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  );
Prompt: Total amount disbursed for sub-prime mortgages during this month?
